scope: Each exported SOME/IP parameter individually reviewed with type/unit/default/applicability/dependency/source/edition; industry-neutral path despite AUTOSAR source authorship.

UDP/TCP/UDP-TP separate typed bindings with no Ethernet PHY assumption; 1400 payload and1392 segment are recommendations, not blanket limits; actual qualified UDP budget and TCP buffer/stream bounds remain device/project inputs.

16-byte header, length=8+payload or12+segment,32-bit message/request ID combinations, protocol1 versus actual interface major, request-response correlation and session wrap/inactive rules. Request/event ID split remains a recommendation, not an invented mandatory cap.

Header/length/tag fields big endian while scalar payload byte order is configurable; table6.2 source defaults, fixed/dynamic length widths and TLV same nonzero inherited width/alignment1. Actual codec trace remains independent evidence.

TP offset16-byte units, nonfinal segment alignment, sender zero reserved/receiver ignore, actual buffer/full unique bytes/timeouts and qualified CP burst/separation+budget. No automatic buffer or timeout fabrication.

Directional magic cookies distinct from application service/event client/session rules. Independent E2E protection profile does not certify safety or full timing. Operational acceptance requires binding/codec/version/correlation and complete source/network/consumer/freshness evidence.
Foreign local bus evidence cannot certify SOME/IP. Runtime MODEL_MISSING explicit; passing parameter validation alone does not prove hardware capacity or all application execution.

Initial isolated series794 PASS and1 stale shared test failure: blanket Ethernet bitrate assumption replaced by explicit SOME/IP transport source and required UDP/TCP binding. Fresh passing XML required before record.
797 isolated tests PASS, 180 native andnine shared suites.
